CHANGED IN VERSION 1.2:


-	(2013)	Don't use the phase_cor_autom_1 anymore for the metabolite spectra after the eddy current correction, because the eddy current correction does nothing than phasing the signal with 
			some SVD analysis of the water data, which is very robust. And then it would be phased just according to the low-amplitude water suppressed NAA (?) peak, which will more dephase than
			properly phase the signal.
